mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STATS_FT_VIEW (ISFVIEW_NO, ILAW_ID, SGUBUN_ID, ICNT, SINS_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{lawId}, #{gubunId}, 1, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT v.ILAW_ID AS LAW_ID, NVL(MAX(p.STITLE), '(미상 ' || v.ILAW_ID || ')') AS LABEL, MAX(c.SNAME) AS CATE_NM, MAX(o.ORGNZT_NM) AS DEPT_NM, SUM(v.ICNT) AS CNT FROM TB_STATS_FT_VIEW v LEFT JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.ILAW_ID = v.ILAW_ID AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_CATE c ON c.ICATE_NO = p.ICATE_NO LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = NVL(p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID, 'ORG_' || LPAD(p.IBUSEO_NO, 16, '0')) WHERE v.SINS_DT BETWEEN #{vo.fromDt} AND #{vo.toDt} GROUP BY v.ILAW_ID ORDER BY CNT DESC, LAW_ID ) X LIMIT 200
SELECT NVL(SUM(ICNT), 0) FROM TB_STATS_FT_VIEW WHERE ILAW_ID = #{lawId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STATS_BBS_VIEW (ISBVIEW_NO, SBBS_ID, INTT_ID, ICNT, SINS_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{bbsId}, #{nttId}, 1, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT v.SBBS_ID AS BBS_ID, v.INTT_ID AS NTT_ID, NVL(MAX(m.BBS_NM), '(삭제 게시판)') AS BBS_NM, NVL(MAX(b.NTT_SJ), '(삭제글)') AS LABEL, MAX(b.USE_AT) AS USE_AT, SUM(v.ICNT) AS CNT FROM TB_STATS_BBS_VIEW v LEFT JOIN COMTNBBS b ON b.NTT_ID = v.INTT_ID AND RTRIM(b.BBS_ID) = v.SBBS_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNBBSMASTER m ON RTRIM(m.BBS_ID) = v.SBBS_ID WHERE v.SINS_DT BETWEEN #{vo.fromDt} AND #{vo.toDt} GROUP BY v.SBBS_ID, v.INTT_ID ORDER BY CNT DESC, BBS_ID, NTT_ID ) X LIMIT 200
mapper.sql: WHERE w.OCCRRNC_DE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vo.fromDt}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND w.OCCRRNC_DE < STR_TO_DATE(#{vo.toDt}, '%Y-%m-%d') + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND w.URL NOT LIKE '%Json.do' AND w.URL NOT LIKE '/WEB-INF/%' AND w.URL <> '/validator.do'

choose.when:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY B.LABEL) > 1 THEN B.LABEL || ' (' || CASE WHEN B.MENU_SE = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' ELSE '사용자' END || ')' ELSE B.LABEL END AS LABEL, B.CNT, B.UCNT FROM ( SELECT m.MENU_NO, m.MENU_NM AS LABEL, MAX(m.MENU_SE) AS MENU_SE, COUNT(*) AS CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(w.RQESTER_ID, w.RQESTER_IP)) AS UCNT FROM COMTNWEBLOG w JOIN COMTNPROGRMLIST p ON p.URL = w.URL AND p.PROGRM_FILE_NM <> 'folder' JOIN COMTNMENUINFO m ON m.PROGRM_FILE_NM = p.PROGRM_FILE_NM
GROUP BY m.MENU_NO, m.MENU_NM ) B ORDER BY B.CNT DESC, LABEL ) X LIMIT 30
choose.otherwise:
SELECT AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(w.RQESTER_ID, w.RQESTER_IP)) AS UCNT FROM COMTNWEBLOG w
GROUP BY ORDER BY
CNT DESC, LABEL LABEL

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(w.RQESTER_ID, w.RQESTER_IP)) AS UCNT FROM COMTNWEBLOG w

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.SKWD AS LABEL, SUM(k.ICNT) AS CNT FROM TB_STATS_KWD k WHERE k.SINS_DT BETWEEN #{vo.fromDt} AND #{vo.toDt} AND k.SKWD IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(k.SKWD) != '' GROUP BY k.SKWD ORDER BY CNT DESC ) X LIMIT 200

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NVL(o.ORGNZT_NM, '(미지정)') AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_PROM p LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = p.SBUSEO_ORGNZT_ID WHERE p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY o.ORGNZT_NM ORDER BY CNT DESC ) X LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ACT_LOG (IALOG_NO, STASK, SREF_TABLE, IREF_NO, SNAME, SUSER_ID, SUSER_NAME, SINS_DT, SINS_IP) VALUES (#{id}, #{task}, NVL(#{refTable,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-'), NVL(#{refNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-'), NVL(#{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-'), NVL(#{userNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-')), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{ip,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.STASK, a.SUSER_ID, a.SUSER_NAME, a.SREF_TABLE, a.SNAME, SUBSTR(a.SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS SINS_DT, a.SINS_IP FROM TB_ACT_LOG a
ORDER BY a.IALOG_NO DESC LIMIT #{vo.recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{vo.firstIndex}
SELECT STASK FROM ( SELECT STASK, COUNT(*) C FROM TB_ACT_LOG WHERE STASK IS NOT NULL GROUP BY STASK ORDER BY C DESC ) X LIMIT 20
